label: t05_01
text:
I came across the desert with Cyclizar, and I’m
totally exhausted!\c
Healing up my team at the Pokémon Center gives
this human a chance to rest up, too!

label: t05_03
text: This is Porto Marinada. Our famed market is\nalways bustling!

label: t05_08
text: Come on up, stop on by! All our goods are\nfresher than fresh! Anything catch your eye?

label: t05_10
text: Marinada comes from marinating, you know?\c\nWhen you soak food like meat or fish in lemon\njuice or vinegar sauce... Mmm, it’s delish!

label: t05_11
text: The food here is really yummy!\c\nEverything’s fresh and wriggly! Kinda like me!

label: t05_37
text:
There’s a battle court right here in the market.\c
Nobody’s allowed to get into fights here—if
you’ve gotta work something out, you do it
through a friendly Pokémon battle!

label: t05_38
text:
People say that a long time ago, ’fore I was even
born, there were always fights breaking out here.\c
But not anymore! Now we get lots of tourists, and
even kids can walk around and feel safe.

label: t05_39
text:
Look at you, li’l M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0302)]r.iss Student! Here to try your
hand at the auction?\c
Careful you don’t drive the price up too high, or
you’ll be crying into your empty pockets!

label: t05_52
text: When night falls upon the city, ghostly Pokémon\nappear up above...\c\nWhy do you think they come?

label: t05_66
text: A salty breeze coming in over the sea is so nice!\c\nI wonder if Steel-type Pokémon hate it, though?\nAll that salt must do a number on them...

label: t05_73
text: It’s so handy having a Pokémon you can ride!\nFeels like I oughta return the favor and let my\r\nPokémon ride on my back instead sometimes! Ha!

label: t05_82
text: More junk mail! Ugh!\c\nMaybe I’ll just crumple it all up into a ball that I\ncan throw around with my Pokémon...

label: t05_83
text:
These big, long metal box things here are what
we call shipping containers.\c
We pack ’em full of goods and things to sell,
then ship ’em off across the sea.

label: t05_85
text: To get to other regions, we go by boat! Our\npoor Pokémon couldn’t carry us that far.

label: t05_86
text:
I swam to those rocks out in the water, and I’m
pretty sure I spotted something on top of them.\c
But I don’t know how to get up there... I’m no
pro at climbing cliffs or anything...

label: t05_87
text: Yesss! I love goofy face boards! It never gets old\ntaking silly photos with ’em!

label: t05_88
text: Hey, so, like...I get Finizen’s deal. I’ve seen them\naround. But what about that macho-looking one?\r\nIs that...a different Pokémon or something?

label: t05_89
text:
Oh my gosh, I’ve gotta get a shot of those
Kilowattrel flying over the ocean for my feed!\c
You sometimes find ’em resting on the beach
just outside town, too.

label: t05_95
text: Have you been to eat at the Kofu Lounge in\nCascarrafa? They serve up all the freshest hauls\r\nthere—direct from Porto Marinada, of course!

label: t05_96
text:
Ol’ man Kofu from the Cascarrafa Gym drops by
the market from time to time.\c
That old coot gets so excited whenever he wins
at the auction that he dances a merry little jig!

label: t05_97
text: When I was younger, I got into my fair share of\nbidding wars and brawls both. I was a real spitfire!

label: t05_121
text: It’s such a nice beach, yet almost no one knows\nabout it! People just flock to the market instead.
